content: document.execCommand is spec-deprecated but has no full replacement for insertText; execCommand preserves native undo history and (per fregante/text-field-edit) fires a real input event with inputType 'insertText' when it succeeds, whereas setRangeText() is a pure programmatic value mutation that never fires input/beforeinput events at all. Firefox has had historical bugs (Bugzilla 1220696) with execCommand('insertText') on plain textarea/input; Blink/WebKit support has been solid since ~2017.
